designs.heading: Supervising the Christmas Tree Cat Retro
designs.title: Supervising the Christmas Tree Cat Retro
designs.description: Every cat owner knows the tree needs supervision. A retro orange tabby sits beside the Christmas tree, keeping a very close eye on the ornaments. A fun gift for cat moms, cat dads and anyone whose tree has been inspected by a cat.
